description: Students learn how to search journal papers, prepare a report and present a seminar. The seminar enhances their knowledge in a new technology domain and develops writing, professional, teamwork, ethics and communication skills. It is evaluated on the basis of a presentation cum viva-voce examination and the report submitted by the candidate.
outcomes: Develop interest towards research-oriented fields with the ability to search the literature and prepare a brief report.
Develop the skills, competencies and points of view needed by professionals in fields closely related to electrical engineering.
Discuss and think critically about topics of current intellectual importance.
